Feature selection via K-best reduces dimensionality to 13 key metrics, achieving a modest receiver operating characteristic area under the curve (AUC) of 0.674. While the model shows promise for early screening, its practical utility is limited by the low precision at high recall, typical of rare-event prediction with extreme class imbalance. The primary failure mode is unreliable generalization when the distribution of subsequent rookie cohorts shifts, emphasizing the need for robust out-of-sample validation and careful calibration of predicted probabilities.
